name: claude-talk-to-figma-mcp
description: Claude Desktop Talk to Figma MCP

scripts.build:compile: bun run compile:server && bun run compile:socket
scripts.compile:all-platforms: bun run compile:linux && bun run compile:mac-arm && bun run compile:win
scripts.compile:linux: bun build ./src/socket.ts --compile --minify --target=bun-linux-x64 --outfile dist/bin/figma-socket-linux-x64 && bun build ./src/talk_to_figma_mcp/server.ts --compile --minify --target=bun-linux-x64 --outfile dist/bin/figma-mcp-server-linux-x64
scripts.compile:mac-arm: bun build ./src/socket.ts --compile --minify --target=bun-darwin-arm64 --outfile dist/bin/figma-socket-darwin-arm64 && bun build ./src/talk_to_figma_mcp/server.ts --compile --minify --target=bun-darwin-arm64 --outfile dist/bin/figma-mcp-server-darwin-arm64
scripts.compile:win: bun build ./src/socket.ts --compile --minify --target=bun-windows-x64 --outfile dist/bin/figma-socket-windows-x64.exe && bun build ./src/talk_to_figma_mcp/server.ts --compile --minify --target=bun-windows-x64 --outfile dist/bin/figma-mcp-server-windows-x64.exe
scripts.sync-version: VERSION=$(jq -r '.version' package.json) && jq --arg version "$VERSION" '.version = $version' manifest.json > manifest.tmp && mv manifest.tmp manifest.json
scripts.build:dxt: npm run sync-version && npm run build && npm run pack
scripts.test:all: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:socket

author: Xúlio Zé
